_readme.about: This file controls the app cards shown on the Ink ecosystem page. Edit it directly — no coding required.

schema.id: Unique identifier (lowercase, no spaces). Used internally — do not change once the app is live.
schema.name: Display name shown on the card.
schema.category: Category label(s) used for the filter bar. Can be a string or an array of strings.
schema.tags: Internal tag array — used for filtering logic. Keep lowercase.
schema.description: One- or two-sentence description shown on the card. Plain text only.
schema.context_note: Optional short note shown below the description (plain text). Set to null to hide it. Use this for timely context such as 'Currently in beta — expect limited liquidity' or 'Audited by XYZ — mainnet launch Q3 2025'.
schema.tvl_millions: Total Value Locked in millions of USD. Set to null if not applicable or unknown.
schema.volume_24h_millions: 24-hour trading/bridge volume in millions of USD. Set to null if not applicable or unknown.
schema.unique_users_24h: Number of unique active addresses in the last 24 hours. Set to null if not applicable or unknown.

action.label: Button label.
action.type: 'link' opens a URL directly. 'panel' shows a step-by-step drawer.
action.steps: Array of steps (for type: 'panel' only). Each step has 'step' (heading), 'detail' (body text), and optionally 'url' (action link on the last step).

context_note_examples: Currently in beta — expect higher slippage.
Audited by OpenZeppelin. Mainnet launch Q3 2025.
Highest TVL on Ink as of May 2025.
Bridge takes ~2 minutes. No withdrawal delay.
how_to_add_an_app: 1. Copy any existing app block below.
3. Fill in name, category, tags, description, and action.
4. Set context_note to a short string, or null to leave it blank.
5. Set tvl_millions, volume_24h_millions, unique_users_24h to numbers or null.
6. Add a trailing comma after the previous app block.
